## Investigation

Can the controller's observed MIDI/MPE output drive a non-ROLI sound source
while the host remains offline?

::: {.manual-prereq title="Require observed output, not assumption"}

Confirm that `seaboard-block-01-midi-mpe.yml` records at least ordinary MIDI.
Choose a locally installed, non-ROLI instrument or synth and record its name
and version. Do not download or purchase software for this experiment. If the
intention specification does not name independent playback, revise it before
continuing.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Create a reproducible routing record"}

Copy the template:

```bash
cp evidence/templates/independent-sound.yml evidence/records/seaboard-block-01-independent-sound.yml
```

Record the MIDI input, sound source, output device, and whether it is configured
for ordinary MIDI or MPE. Keep the route as simple as possible: controller to
one sound source to one audio output.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Repeat the fixed gesture set"}

Repeat the Stage 3 gesture set and listen for note triggering and expressive
response. Record audible results separately from message observations. A synth
that cannot interpret MPE does not disprove MPE output; it only limits this
particular playback test.

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Evaluate independent playability"}

Mark ordinary independent playback `confirmed` only if notes sounded through a
named non-ROLI source offline. Mark expressive independent playback `confirmed`
only if the sound source was configured for MPE and responded as recorded.
Keep all other claims separate.

:::
